name: AutoConnect Fleet Management System
description: The AutoConnect Fleet Management System enables organizations to monitor, maintain, and optimize their vehicle fleets in real time. It integrates telematics, predictive maintenance, and driver behavior analytics to improve operational efficiency. The platform supports multiple vehicle types and provides a unified dashboard for analytics and reporting.
objectives: Provide real-time GPS tracking and monitoring of fleet vehicles.
Automate maintenance scheduling based on usage and sensor data.
Generate actionable analytics on fuel consumption and driver efficiency.
Enable mobile access for drivers and managers via a responsive application.
Integrate with existing ERP and accounting systems for expense tracking.
success_criteria: Achieve at least 95% system uptime for critical tracking services.
Reduce average vehicle downtime by 20% through predictive maintenance.
Increase fuel efficiency by 10% across the fleet.
Provide role-based access to over 500 concurrent users with sub-second response times.
Generate monthly reports that are accurate within 1% of actual mileage.
